overview: Built an internal Constellation Alignment Tool gated by platform Development Mode (detectPlatformRuntimeMode). When development is enabled, /moment opens a split preview + editor that reuses production ConstellationRenderer and resolveConstellation — no duplicated drawing pipeline. Operators can add multiple constellation instances, switch catalog definitions and artwork, edit transform/artwork/vertices/draw-order/graph-edges live, toggle display overlays, and Copy Configuration JSON for pasting back into constellation JSON files. Production mode (PLATFORM_RUNTIME_MODE=production) continues to render FindUsMoment only with no editor chrome. Validated with typecheck, eslint, unit tests (11), memories-web build, and docker deploy; visual capture under docs/artifacts/moments/find-us/alignment-tool/.
executiveSummary: Alignment is now a Development Mode authoring surface on the shared production renderer. Geometry, artwork, and draw paths can be tuned with sliders/tables and exported via clipboard — without changing the production Moment when Development Mode is off.
userVisibleChanges: Development Mode: /moment shows the Constellation Alignment Tool (preview + panel)
Production Mode: /moment remains Find Us with no editor UI
architectureChanges: ConstellationAlignmentTool composes ConstellationRenderer + resolveConstellation for live drafts
AlignmentOverlay adds dev-only guides (UIDs, centres, bbox, draw-order indices) without reimplementing stars/artwork
Catalog helpers: cloneConstellation, listConstellationIds; exportConstellationConfig for pasteable JSON
configurationChanges: site-memories depends on @platform/runtime for Development Mode detection
Docker default PLATFORM_RUNTIME_MODE=development exposes the tool; set production to restore Find Us on /moment

testingPerformed.detail: Browser capture of alignment tool with Leo preview + panel

knownLimitations: Development Mode is build/runtime env (PLATFORM_RUNTIME_MODE), not a live preference toggle — switching requires rebuild/redeploy
In Development Mode /moment is the tool, not the Find Us ritual (by design for this gate)
Catalog registration still requires a code import for new constellation JSON files
Artwork catalog is a small static map; new assets need a catalog entry
No drag handles (intentional); no persistence beyond clipboard
recommendedNextMilestone: Use the alignment tool to refine Leo/Sag artwork registration and Sag Euler drawOrder, paste configs back into constellation JSON, then restore Find Us ritual validation under PLATFORM_RUNTIME_MODE=production before visual polish.
